Yoshi said he needed bigger gains 💪🪿—so I 3D-printed him muscle hands on the Creality SparkX i7. The best part? The model is easy to resize for any pet, and the prints are lightweight, so they’re actually comfortable to wear instead of bulky like the ones I used to buy online.
Printed with K2 Pro
This is the Creality K2 Pro 3D printer. See how the Creality K2 Pro brings oddly satisfying 3D printed creations to life — smooth, colorful, and precise, layer by layer.
They call it Sweet Victory for a reason. With football fever building, this 3D-printed trophy arrives just in time for the big season ahead—making every victory feel even sweeter.
Where functionality meets sculptural elegance. This 3D-printed napkin holder transforms an everyday essential into a striking work of art.
Creality’s second generation “flagship” series finally feels complete, with the K2 Pro and it’s 300mm³ build volume sitting pretty as the best-of-all worlds.

The SPARKX i7 is a simple bed slinger with a lot of heart and a budget price. The color system it uses is enclosed, and it works extremely well for something this cheap. The CNET test print gave excellent results with strong towers and excellent dimensional accuracy, and the overall quality is far better than most printers priced so low.

The SPARKX i7 is Creality’s next gen answer to the beginner 3D printer, suitable for all ages with a little adult supervision. It’s simple to unbox, easy to understand and fun to use with an RGB status light that adds colorful personality. The machine is so quiet it can be used in a family room or homework station.

Again Creality impresses with an outstanding machine. This is well-built, packed with features, and ultimately produces outstanding prints. It has great material flexibility, and whilst multifilament printing does slow things down, print speeds are still relatively impressive compared with many of its rivals.
The Creality SPARKX i7 lights a fire under the entry-level 3D printer market, offering exceptional value from a machine that's easy to set up and can print in multiple colors.
